description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Craterclaw Colossus.
When the Craterclaw Colossus tokens enter, they each trigger.
Resolve a Craterclaw Colossus trigger, giving each creature you control +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
Repeat step 3 for the remaining triggers.
